title.value: Lo studio della cultura visiva moderna

overview.value: An introduction episode explaining how Kohsaka, Kasukabe and Sasahara got involved with Genshiken; after some uncertainty, Sasahara decides to fully participate in the club.

title.value: Classificazione comparativa tra consumo e diversità nella gioventù moderna

overview.value: Genshiken takes Sasahara to Akihabara for dōjinshi shopping while Kohsaka and Kasukabe go to Harajuku for clothes; Kasukabe discovers Kohsaka's hentai collection and gets an introduction on the subject from the others.

title.value: Problemi e meriti di promozione della cultura locale

overview.value: Genshiken goes on a club trip to Comifes, a large comic convention; Madarame seriously injures his hand, but pretends to be fine in the name of fandom until the pain becomes too great to bear.

title.value: Il processo complesso dei blocchi mentali che riguarda la diversità tra vestito e costume

overview.value: Ohno is introduced as she joins Genshiken, while Genshiken takes part in a university club fair and Kasukabe's ex-boyfriend pays her a visit.

title.value: Il confronto tra rifiuto e accettazione visto nel comportamento autonomo

overview.value: Due to Genshiken's lack of "activities" as defined by the school, the club is threatened with closure; salvation comes from an unlikely source as Kasukabe intervenes personally.

title.value: Il rapporto con gli altri attraverso la sottocultura

overview.value: Kasukabe tries to make herself more appealing to Kohsaka by taking an interest in his hobbies by trying to learn how to play Puyo Pop Fever. Sasahara's sister Keiko also makes an appearance and calls on her brother for help.

title.value: Caratteristiche di azioni e decisioni nelle relazioni interpersonali

overview.value: Two freshmen take an interest in Genshiken and join them for a night out on the town. Kasukabe, however, has no intention of making them feel welcome.

title.value: Ricerca comparativa del processo di produzione di massa

overview.value: Ohno and Sasahara start a plamo project and get the whole club involved, while Kasukabe learns an important lesson.

title.value: L'esistenza e l'inesistenza di compiti esplicativi in speciali situazioni isolate

overview.value: Madarame is stuck in the club room with Kasukabe and tries to strike up a conversation, running through different scenarios in his head which parody the visual novel format.

title.value: Il tempo passato a fare quello che piace è considerato ben speso

overview.value: The club, along with Keiko, pays a visit to the beach, much to the dismay of some of the members; Keiko decides to compete for Kohsaka's feelings and tries to become an otaku.

title.value: La posizione malizia nel fenomeno del crimine urbano

overview.value: Kasukabe decides the club room needs a cleanup, but an accident causes Genshiken to be banned from the university fair. As an apology, Kasukabe takes Ohno's place in the fair's cosplay contest.

title.value: Le contromisure e i problemi che si sollevano quando un'organizzazione subisce un rinnovamento

overview.value: The club is depressed due to their punishment of community service. Sasahara becomes the new President and proposes that the society attend Comifes as a circle.
